features: Collapsed/expandable four-player TEAM HUD, existing authoritative hearts and derived teammate status.
Host-validated Help Here, Need Medkit, Revive Teammate and Go to Portal signals, four-second cooldown, twelve-second lifetime, bounded one-per-actor checkpoint receipts.
Read-only direction arrow, distance and pooled ring/beacon for authenticated pings, active topic, available rescue, or final portal.
Skippable first-visit lobby briefing with four scrollable pages, visible scrollbar and HOW TO PLAY review button.
PLAY AGAIN returns the finished online match to the same room/party; new ready epoch, fresh checkpoint, cleared cached avatars and opposite starting guardian.
Host-handoff safe retained lobby; explicit Leave still leaves independently.
Disabled redundant preview-camera listeners in Main Menu; one listener remains active.
